name: EthnoGuessr
summary:
This game uses anthropological data from humanphenotypes.net. You will be shown male and female facial averages from a given ethnic group. Your job is to guess on the map where they are from, historically.

You will score points proportional to how close you are to the primary map region.

After making your guess, the ethnic group's name and some information will be displayed for educational purposes

Every day there will be a new set of 10 races to play!
